text: 金十数据7月27日讯，文章称，7月22日，美国白宫科技政策办公室主任迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯突然在社交媒体上宣称，中国AI企业“月之暗面”通过蒸馏美国Anthropic公司的Fable开发Kimi K3大模型。仅仅几个小时后，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特发文威胁，要用制裁和“实体清单”来应对中国企业的蒸馏。中国在AI领域的发展与成就全球有目共睹。美国部分政客身处关乎美国科技发展的关键职位，应当做内行人，不应老说外行话，信口开河地污蔑中国大模型靠蒸馏，这样只能让自己看起来很业余。
text_en: Jin10 Data July 27: An article stated that on July 22, US White House OSTP Director Michael Kratsios suddenly claimed on social media that Chinese AI firm 'Moonshot AI' distilled US Anthropic's Fable to develop Kimi K3. Just hours later, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatened sanctions and 'entity list' to target Chinese firms' distillation. China's AI development achievements are globally recognized. US politicians in key tech positions should act professionally, not make amateur allegations about Chinese AI models relying on distillation.
